# A test of a component that is not the window reads `pages.current` of a
# stack whose pages include one served at a pattern, with or without a
# `titleOf`.
#
# On html a test reads `current` from the record each document publishes,
# and a document published it only where its own script read `current` at run
# time -- a `nav.link`'s state, say. Here the fold settled every read the
# document makes, so it published nothing, and the test, whose script is its
# own, read `undefined`. A test build's documents now always publish it.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import "sngl:test"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Mon {
    name string
}

component site ui.node {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #detail(href=`/p/{name}`, title="Pokémon", titleOf=func(p Mon) => p.name, params=Mon{name="bulbasaur"}) {
            component content(p) {
                ui.text(value=p.name)
            }
        }
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
            ui.text(value="home")
        }
    }
    ui.text #heading(value="Site - {pages.current.title}")
}

ui.window(title="Site") {
    site()
}

func testTheCurrentPageIsTheRoot(t test.Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.home)
    t.assert(c.pages.current != c.detail)
}

func testTheCurrentPagesTitleIsRead(t test.Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.pages.current.title == "Home")
    t.assert(c.heading.value == "Site - Home")
}
